2610.08093.title: SAGE: Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution for Grounded Medical QA Data Synthesis
2610.08093.paper_summary: Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE.
2610.08093.paper_summary_zh: 開發可靠的臨床任務模型，例如醫療問題回答（QA），受到高品質、專家標註的訓練數據有限可用性的嚴重限制。這一挑戰因嚴格的隱私要求以及在資源有限的臨床環境中使用大型開源語料庫或專有雲端API的實用性不足而加劇。為了解決這些障礙，我們介紹了SAGE（\textit{語義錨點引導演化}），這是一個新穎的數據合成框架，使小型本地部署模型能夠生成高品質的醫療訓練數據。SAGE利用輕量級的公共可用分類法，如MeSH，作為語義錨點，施加結構化的先驗，以有效引導和基礎數據生成過程。SAGE的核心是迭代地交錯原子（基於個別概念）和關聯（基於關係）合成，從最小的種子啟動訓練數據。這種方法消除了對大量醫療文檔的需求或對外部API的依賴，為本地數據創建提供了一種實用的解決方案。在多個醫療問題回答基準上的廣泛實驗表明，使用SAGE合成數據進行微調的模型始終優於使用自我衍生或傳統文檔基礎範式訓練的模型，突顯了在醫療LLM開發中數據效率和資源利用的實質性改善。代碼可在https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE獲得。
